decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own page in both years, so the firm presents it as a core offer that appears to meet aspirations, and it fits the brand's gentle-natural positioning well enough to justify keeping it.

The hyaluronic serum has stayed listed for two years and sits in a high-demand category close to the core range, so with no evident shortfall triggering problemistic search, the firm will likely carry it.

The cleansing oil is newly launched and appears to fill the cleansing gap left by the dropped cleansing milk, and its low production costs in an in-house small-batch setting let the firm give it time before judging it against aspirations.
